args.title: Remember last used export format
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Change the behavior of the export format selector to remember the last used format. Save the selected format in local or session storage and set it as the default format when the component mounts. This addresses user complaints of the format resetting to CSV.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The export format selection resets to CSV by default each time. To enhance usability, the system should remember the last format used by storing it in local storage, thereby preventing errors and improving user efficiency.
